health.exposureInfo: This section shows anonymized risk in your network. Example: you (John) are connected to Ana. Ana is connected to Luis. Luis reports a positive result. You will see an exposure at 2nd degree, without names. **It only shows counts and the closest degree.**
health.myResultsInfo: This section is your personal log. Example: you went to a clinic, got a lab test, and learned you are positive for HPV. You then add it here so your status and network risk update. **Only you can see this list.**
health.whatItMeansBody: We never show names—only anonymized counts and degrees. Exposure does not mean infection. Use this information to consider testing and care.

privacy.description: Your privacy is our priority. We never share personal information - only anonymized statistics.

landing.heroNote: Built for discretion, clarity, and control.
landing.stepOneBody: Connect privately using usernames or email. Only confirmed connections shape your network graph.
landing.stepTwoTitle: Share health status on your terms
landing.stepTwoBody: Log positive or negative results without exposing identities. You control what is visible.
landing.stepThreeBody: Navilla shows exposure levels and counts by condition — never names.
landing.valueOneBody: We prioritize anonymized insights so you can act without exposing personal details.
landing.valueTwoBody: Clear, calm summaries help you decide next steps at your own pace.
landing.valueThreeBody: No public identities, no social graph — just the information you need.
